headline: STL @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 3.55 at NYM 3.70, with a projected total of 7.25. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (STL +0.22, NYM +0.16), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.38, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Freddy Peralta has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Carson Benge, Jordan Walker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Vidal Bruján because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
